source_scope.source_policy: Immutable pedagogical source records; classifications do not rewrite source wording or establish dialect-wide productivity.

decision.contract_scope: Bounded discourse metadata over overt adjacent dialog turns; member-local application only; no hidden words or synthetic children.
decision.aa66_disposition: AA66 ContextLinkedAnswerUtteranceWrapper may carry compatibility-level answer metadata for structurally heterogeneous licensed responses; this review does not establish one shared fragment syntax or change its identity/status.
decision.aa96_disposition: AA96 UnresolvedContextDiagnostic remains justified only when a typed slot or discourse relation has no unique compatible antecedent; one reviewed row remains unresolved.

accepted_contract.member_locality: Apply context licensing only to the response or connective-bearing member; preserve independently parsed members and overt source order.
licensed_relations: positive or negative answer to an overt polar, A-not-A, offer, permission, time, location, possession/existence, skill, preference, or acceptability prompt
quantified answer whose activity or measurement domain is overt in the previous question
reciprocal fragment question such as 你呢 reusing one uniquely established question domain
discourse connective such as 但係 or 不過 linking an overt current clause to one compatible immediately preceding proposition
predicate or object repetition whose omitted discourse domain is uniquely overt in the preceding question
blocked_relations: semantic relation not supported by the immediately preceding turn
formula interpreted by inventing a unique hidden predicate
context used to repair an independently complete parser miss
context licensing applied to the whole turn when only one member depends on context
accepted_contract.nonfabrication: Store antecedent turn ID, overt surface, linked semantic/discourse slots, and selected alternative only. Do not synthesize omitted Cantonese words, hidden clauses, or a universal ellipsis analysis.

independent_parser_routes.profile: 如果 + condition + 點算 contingency question
overt-predicate 得 sufficiency and event-level 得唔得 acceptability
complete skill-learning desiderative, evaluative, and A-not-A clauses
